steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 48
steps.text: In this C2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: I always procrastinate on Sunday nights.
I finally got used to waking up early.
I do grocery shopping every Saturday.

steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Passive Voice"?
options: He told me he would call later.

steps.title: Idiom: Get out of hand
steps.text: It means: "To become uncontrollable.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: The party got out of hand pretty quickly.
